text: Analysis focuses on finding that portion of the current action standard group that has the most homogeneous product wants; and accordingly provides the most consistent product direction.
Groups were divided by age, sex, and brand smoked.
King - exclude Kool Box Males -> they want more strength than any other competitive group.
Exclude 40+ Salem females from franchise action standard as they want less strength than all other franchise groups.
R-I: Divergent wants among franchise and competitive groups.
Given this difference in improvement direction, MDD recommends that the smoker groups with the most extreme R-I rating on strength and mildness dimensions be excluded from the action standard.
Specifically: Kool Box Males, who want more strength than any other competitive group.
